character: huge smug alligator gar, armoured scales, long tooth-packed snout, gold tooth, fills two thirds of frame
props: a shoal of tiny debtor fish in cheap ties - their place is his snout and back every window until 7.75, never open water; a fat paper contract he chews; a coin purse on a string; a torn banknote
prop_continuity: the contract stays in his teeth from 1.2 and shreds a little in every window; the purse swings from his jaw all ten seconds
motion_rule: every window he covers water - surging at the lens, rolling belly-up or sweeping round, never hovering to speak; the debtor fish cling to his snout and he shakes and snaps at them; new shot size every window
environment: sunlit shallow river running at the lens, bright noon light; background under a third

audio.delivery: oily gloating male voice, biting off each word, native Russian stress
audio.pronunciation: stress: kre-DI-ty, pre-KRAS-na-ya, SHTU-ka, pro-glo-TIT, ZA-zhi-vo, so-VSEM, ot-CHA-yal-sya, vkus-NYA-ti-na
audio.pacing: brisk, no drawling; nothing said after 7.75
audio.lip_sync: mouth moves on every syllable, snout clear of props while speaking
audio.sfx: water surge, snapping jaws, paper tearing, bubbles, coin clink

timeline.a: erupts out of the depth at the lens, water wall behind
surges at the lens, snout filling frame, debtor fish scattering off his scales
snatches the contract in his teeth and shakes it, shreds flying at the lens
rolls his whole body over, the shoal sliding round his back
timeline.c: whip to mid, rolling with him

timeline.a: sweeps round and drives back the other way, purse swinging off his jaw
opens the snout wide and hoovers three debtor fish in at once
timeline.c: big low, open jaws at the lens

timeline.a: charges the lens with the tails still kicking between his teeth
flicks his tail and cuts sideways, dragging the whole shoal with him
rears out of the water and shakes the shoal off his snout at the lens
closes on the lens until the gold tooth fills it, purse swinging into shot
snaps the purse open and one torn banknote flies at the lens
he rolls belly-up sated, the shredded contract raining down
the surviving debtor fish stampede past the lens the other way, growing huge
he sweeps past the lens wiping the frame, gold tooth flashing

must_appear: contract shredding in his teeth from 1.2; three fish hoovered in at 3.05; tails kicking between his teeth at 3.75; gold tooth filling frame at 6.25; banknote at the lens at 6.85
negative_prompt: night, dark scene, murky water, subtitles, watermark, cyrillic, garbled or misspelled words, static camera, same shot size twice, he hovers still while speaking, his snout hidden, a prop across his mouth while speaking, a debtor fish in open water before 7.75, a window where the shoal does nothing, him small in frame, extra fins, deformed anatomy, English speech, any word after 7.75
